headline: After 44 Years in a Barn, Elephant Sandro Finds Freedom
meta_description: Sandro, an elephant at Sorocaba Zoo for 44 years, moves to a spacious 13-acre sanctuary after spending nights confined in a barn barely taller than himself.
summary_short: After four decades at Sorocaba Zoo, elephant Sandro has finally moved to a 13-acre sanctuary habitat—a dramatic change from the cramped barn where he spent his nights.
body:
After 44 years at Sorocaba Zoo, elephant Sandro has moved to a new 13-acre sanctuary habitat, offering him space and freedom he never had before.

For decades, Sandro endured nights confined to a barn barely inches taller than his own body, spending 16 hours there each night. The contrast between his old enclosure and his new sanctuary is stark—from a structure so restrictive he could barely stand upright to an expansive outdoor habitat designed to meet his needs.

Sandro's second night in the sanctuary marks the beginning of a new chapter for the aging elephant. The move represents a significant shift in how the zoo approaches animal welfare, giving one of its oldest residents the space to live more naturally after spending most of his life in inadequate conditions.

Confined to a barn barely taller than the elephant himself
Spent 16 hours each night in the barn enclosure
